newsitem.title: CHINA: China calls for calm over Korea defector.
newsitem.headline: China calls for calm over Korea defector.

text.p: Chinese Foreign Minster Qian Qichen on Friday called for Pyongyang and Seoul to take a cool-headed approach to a diplomatic crisis caused by the defection of a senior North Korean leader.

China was still investigating the case of top Pyongyang ideological theoretician Hwang Jang-yop, who has been holed up in South Korea's mission to Beijing since February 12, Qian told a news conference.
"We hope all sides can take a cool-headed attitude so as to solve this problem as soon as possible," Qian said.
The Hwang case was a matter between North and South Korea, but since it had taken place in Beijing it came under Chinese jurisdiction, he said.
"China right now is conducting its investigation. We will follow international law and common international practice to solve this problem," he said.
"At the same time, we will take into account the need to facilitate peace and stability on the Korean Penninsula," Qian said but gave no further details.
